messages.content: Adobe just emailed that the pullout sofa will be unavailable while they replace furniture. They offered a two-queen room instead. Can you verify that works for all three of us and compare it with the Newport backup before changing anything?

The Adobe two-queen room is approved for three guests, so Marcus, Daniel, and Owen can all be listed without a rollaway. Its revised four-night total is $1,588.59, which is $216 more than the current room. The Newport hotel has a two-queen room for three at $1,556.20, including taxes and fees, and it can be canceled through July 29 at 6:00 p.m. Pacific.
So Newport is only about $32 less. What does it do to the driving for the central-coast days?

It saves $32.39 on lodging but adds roughly 80 miles and about two hours of driving across the two outings. From Adobe, allow about 15 minutes each way to Cape Perpetua and 35 minutes each way to Heceta Head. From Newport, those become approximately 40 and 70 minutes each way.
And Adobe's cancellation deadline stays the same after the room change?
Yes. The amended Adobe reservation remains cancelable through July 28 at 4:00 p.m. Pacific. Free parking, the August 5-9 dates, and the rest of the property terms are unchanged.
Take the Adobe two-queen upgrade. Make sure the reservation shows three guests, and don't touch Tolovana, Hampton, the flights, or the car.
The Adobe room has been changed to two queens for three registered guests. The new total is $1,588.59, and confirmation AR-593817 remains valid. No other reservation was modified.
Give me the revised trip total and the driving times I should use for those two days.

Revised lodging is $2,924.68: Tolovana $1,048.44, Adobe $1,588.59, and Hampton $287.65. With transportation unchanged at $2,065, total trip exposure is now $4,989.68 before meals and activities. For the central-coast outings, use about 15 minutes each way between Adobe and Cape Perpetua and 35 minutes each way between Adobe and Heceta Head. Flights UA-8K4R2M, Budget SUV BZ-761943, Tolovana TI-846291, and Hampton HP-274608 remain unchanged.
